note: Team model (Blender export, metres, +Y up, ground at y = 0, station centred near the origin).
_notes: Coordinates are in the model's own frame, metres: [x, z]. seat = parts set on the ground one by one. rover = the part that drives on trips. airlock_exit = where a walk starts. base_walk = loop of the second astronaut ([x, z, 1 = work here]). obstacles = [x, z, radius] circles that routes go around. rescue_rover = the standby vehicle that drives out in an emergency.
